title: 石猴学艺
narrative: 花果山水帘洞中，石猴称王三百余年后，忽然醒悟生死无常，决心远渡重洋寻仙访道。历经艰辛，终于在灵台方寸山斜月三星洞拜得菩提祖师为师。祖师见他根骨奇特，赐法名孙悟空。悟空勤学苦练，白天随众师兄习文练武,夜晚独自参悟玄机。一日，祖师在课堂上敲击悟空头部三下，暗示他三更时分后堂相见。悟空心领神会，三更时分悄然来到祖师寝室。祖师传授他长生之术、七十二般变化和筋斗云神通。悟空天资聪颖，短短数年便练成绝世神功，一个筋斗便可翻越十万八千里。
style_anchor: Chinese ink painting style, mystical mountain atmosphere, soft morning mist, warm candlelight in cave interiors, dynamic martial arts movements with flowing robes, ancient temple architecture

wukong.ref_description: Young Sun Wukong in training attire, golden-brown monkey features, intelligent eyes, blue cloth robe, standing in martial arts ready stance
wukong.appearance: A young monkey with golden-brown fur, bright intelligent eyes, wearing a simple blue cloth robe tied with hemp rope, bare feet, alert posture

patriarch.appearance: An elderly Taoist master with long white beard flowing to chest, serene wise eyes, wearing traditional gray Taoist robes with cloud patterns, wooden staff in hand, dignified bearing

scenes.name: 拜师学艺
scenes.narrative_segment: 历经艰辛，终于在灵台方寸山斜月三星洞拜得菩提祖师为师。祖师见他根骨奇特，赐法名孙悟空。
scenes.summary: 孙悟空在山洞外向菩提祖师行拜师大礼
scenes.visual_description: Misty mountain temple entrance at dawn, stone steps leading to cave, ancient pine trees
scenes.emotion_arc: 虔诚恭敬 → 激动期待
scenes.lighting: soft dawn light, 5500K, gentle side lighting from rising sun, misty atmosphere
scenes.weather: morning mist, light fog rolling through mountains
scenes.environment_description: Ancient cave temple entrance carved into misty mountain cliff face. Worn stone steps lead upward to the cave mouth. Gnarled pine trees cling to rocky outcrops. Distant mountain peaks emerge from sea of clouds below. Dawn light filters through mist creating ethereal atmosphere.

shots.narrative_segment: 历经艰辛，终于在灵台方寸山斜月三星洞
shots.scene_prompt: Wide establishing shot. The monkey stands at the base of stone steps leading up misty mountain, gazing upward at the cave temple entrance above. Morning mist swirls around ancient pine trees. He holds a humble posture, travel-worn but determined.
shots.end_frame_description: The monkey has climbed halfway up the stone steps, now closer to the cave entrance. His posture shows both exhaustion from the journey and reverence as he approaches the sacred place.
shots.action_prompt: Slowly climbs the worn stone steps, one careful step at a time, occasionally pausing to steady himself, mist parting around his moving form
shots.atmosphere_lighting: soft dawn backlight, 5500K, light mist diffusion
shots.physics_note: mist particles swirling, cloth robe moving with steps

shots.narrative_segment: 拜得菩提祖师为师。祖师见他根骨奇特，赐法名孙悟空。
shots.scene_prompt: Medium shot at cave entrance. The monkey kneels on stone ground before the standing Taoist master. The master holds his wooden staff, looking down at the kneeling disciple with penetrating yet kind eyes. Morning light illuminates them from behind.
shots.end_frame_description: The monkey remains kneeling, head bowed deeply in three kowtows. The master has raised one hand in blessing gesture, his expression showing acceptance and slight satisfaction.
shots.action_prompt: The monkey performs three deep kowtows, forehead touching stone ground each time, then remains in kneeling position. The master slowly raises his hand in blessing
shots.atmosphere_lighting: rim light from dawn sun, 5500K, creating silhouette effect with soft fill
shots.physics_note: robe fabric settling with each kowtow, dust motes in light beams

keyframes.description: The monkey's forehead touches the stone ground in the first kowtow, body fully prostrated
The monkey completes the third kowtow and remains kneeling, the master's hand begins to rise

scenes.name: 传授神通
scenes.narrative_segment: 祖师传授他长生之术、七十二般变化和筋斗云神通。悟空天资聪颖，短短数年便练成绝世神功。
scenes.summary: 菩提祖师在洞内向悟空传授七十二变口诀
scenes.visual_description: Candlelit cave interior, master and disciple facing each other
scenes.emotion_arc: 专注聆听 → 顿悟欣喜
scenes.environment_description: Dimly lit cave interior with rough stone walls. Multiple candles on stone ledges cast dancing shadows. Wooden training posts in corners. Meditation cushions on floor. Ancient scrolls on stone shelves. Incense smoke curls upward.

shots.narrative_segment: 祖师传授他长生之术、七十二般变化和筋斗云神通。
shots.scene_prompt: Close-up inside candlelit cave. Master sits cross-legged on meditation cushion, facing kneeling disciple. Candlelight flickers across faces. Master gestures with one hand explaining profound secrets.
shots.end_frame_description: Master has finished speaking and sits in stillness. Disciple remains kneeling but eyes now shine with sudden understanding, enlightenment crossing his face.
shots.action_prompt: Master speaks and gestures slowly explaining mystical techniques. Disciple listens intently, expression gradually shifts from concentration to sudden realization
shots.physics_note: candle flames flickering, incense smoke drifting

shots.narrative_segment: 悟空天资聪颖，短短数年便练成绝世神功。
shots.scene_prompt: Medium shot in cave training area. Monkey stands in martial arts stance among wooden training posts. Candlelight creates dramatic shadows. Posture shows newfound confidence.
shots.end_frame_description: Monkey has completed swift martial movement, frozen in powerful stance with one arm extended. Expression shows joy and pride. Candle flames flicker in background.
shots.action_prompt: Executes rapid martial arts movements - spinning, striking posts, leaping - demonstrating newly learned skills with fluid grace
shots.physics_note: robe flowing with movements, posts shaking from strikes

scenes.name: 初试筋斗云
scenes.narrative_segment: 一个筋斗便可翻越十万八千里。
scenes.summary: 悟空在山崖边施展筋斗云，一跃冲天
scenes.visual_description: Mountain cliff edge at sunrise, vast sky, clouds below
scenes.emotion_arc: 紧张尝试 → 成功喜悦
scenes.weather: clear sky, morning clouds below cliff
scenes.environment_description: Steep mountain cliff edge overlooking vast sea of clouds. Sunrise paints sky in gold and pink. Distant peaks visible. Endless sky opens above. Wind moves through sparse grass on cliff.

shots.narrative_segment: 一个筋斗便可翻越十万八千里。
shots.scene_prompt: Wide shot at cliff edge. Monkey stands at precipice edge, toes at the brink. Sea of clouds stretches below. Sunrise behind him creates silhouette. He takes deep breath, gathering courage.
shots.end_frame_description: Monkey crouches low in preparation stance, arms pulled back, body coiled like spring ready to launch. Expression shows determination mixed with excitement.
shots.action_prompt: Steps cautiously to cliff edge, looks down at clouds below, takes deep breath, then crouches into launching stance
shots.atmosphere_lighting: sunrise backlight, 6500K, rim lighting on silhouette
shots.physics_note: robe fluttering in wind, hair moving

keyframes.description: Monkey peers over cliff edge, looking down at the vast cloud sea below, wind catching his robe

shots.narrative_segment: 一个筋斗便可翻越十万八千里。
shots.scene_prompt: Dynamic shot. Monkey explodes upward from cliff in powerful leap. Body arcs through air. Golden cloud materializes beneath feet. Sky opens wide above.
shots.end_frame_description: Monkey soars high above mountain peaks, riding golden cloud. Arms spread wide in triumph. Expression pure joy. Vast sky and cloud sea surround him. Sunrise illuminates his victorious form.
shots.action_prompt: Launches powerfully upward, golden cloud forms under feet, rises rapidly into sky, spreads arms in exhilaration
shots.atmosphere_lighting: bright sunrise, 6500K, golden light flooding scene
shots.physics_note: robe billowing dramatically, golden cloud particles swirling
